scope: WAN harness, schema_fitting dispatch/fixture guard and workflow; excludes reviewer-authored wan.rs/server/tests
checks: Credential exists only in the final workflow transfer step environment; no token arguments or intentional secret output. Receiver URLs are constrained to HTTPS trycloudflare origins by workflow and the shared HttpClient rejects redirects, embedded credentials, query/fragment and non-loopback plaintext HTTP.

Pinned checkout/upload actions, source/ref/first-attempt gates, read-only repository permission, fresh target and compiler/feature capture. Baseline substitutes only the pinned old schema source, captures diff, restores current source and checks all recorded source hashes.

Plan regenerates deterministic 30-trial/three-shard bounded fixture registrations. Each shard has60 isolated scopes,600 targets40seeds, conservative storage below768MiB; fixed fixture range and unchanged receiver resource limits bound actual transfers.
Session identities bind source maps, executable digests, platform/features, plan and receiver identity labels. The baseline is explicitly source-derived, not a claimed unchanged historical checkout.

No shell interpolation of child arguments; fresh create_new outputs and scoped session scratch directory; child failures and partial rows retained without retries. Successful consolidated rows retain child content hashes.

Stopped-store verifier regenerates all640 expected objects per shard and compares full byte strings. Summary requires1920 unique exact readbacks, registered row order/counts/family labels, body/mode parity, source identities and per-operation receiver cache counter progression.
Sender process CPU and reported receiver handler CPU are disjoint; exchange time is a subset; setup included in session totals; packet/full-path/energy/compliance claims are not made.

resolved_findings.finding: Baseline qualification named nonexistent test target schema_zstd, which would stop the job before WAN execution.
resolved_findings.resolution: Parent replaced it with existing schema_prepared; current command targets schema_codec/schema_prepared/schema_reuse. Reviewer inspected actual test paths and retained workflow-final.txt shows3/3guard tests passed.

limitations: No review of reviewer-authored server implementation; independent server review is separate.
No new builds, tests, experiments or dependency audit were run by this reviewer. Observed existing qualification includes16 harness tests, successful Clippy/build and3 final workflow guard tests.

Plans, executable paths, local evidence files and the operator-controlled receiver are trusted measurement inputs. Source/executable hashes establish custody, not remote hardware attestation. Receiver binary hash is operator supplied.
HTTPS terminates at the relay. This is public synthetic benchmark traffic, not end-to-end encryption or FIPS/CUI qualification.
Approval covers premeasurement harness/workflow security, not a WAN result. Actual workflow execution, stopped-store verification and final results consistency remain required.
